_comment: Mutation-testing experiment. Scoped to src/lib/ — pure, framework-free logic where a surviving mutant is unambiguous. Vue SFCs are deliberately out of scope: Stryker cannot mutate inside <template>, so a .vue score would measure only the <script> block and read misleadingly low.
_comment_plugins: Explicit rather than auto-discovered: bun installs into a hoisted node_modules/.bun/ layout, and Stryker's default glob over node_modules/@stryker-mutator/* does not resolve the runner through it.
_comment_ignoreStatic: Static mutants (module-level const option lists) re-run the entire suite each, 223 of 541 here, and a full run exceeded 20 minutes without finishing. They also measure the least: a surviving mutant in a label array says nothing about test quality. Excluded to keep the score behavioral.
